nodes.name: game.sasm
nodes.content:
.name crystal-dungeon
.entry start

.data title ========================================
.data title2        CRYSTAL DUNGEON : SVM32
.data title3 ========================================
.data choose Choose a gate by writing 1, 2, or 3 to choice.txt.
.data gate1 [Gate 1] Ember Cave - easy monster, 100 reward
.data gate2 [Gate 2] Ancient Forest - strong monster, 160 reward
.data gate3 [Gate 3] Void Citadel - boss monster, 260 reward
.data hit You strike the monster for:
.data monster_left Monster HP remaining:
.data hurt The monster strikes you for:
.data player_left Player HP remaining:
.data victory VICTORY! The crystal is yours.
.data defeat DEFEAT... change the gate or try again.
.data score_label Final score:
.data turns_label Battle turns:
.data new_high NEW HIGH SCORE:
.data old_high Current high score:
.data bad_choice Invalid choice. Use 1, 2, or 3.
.data missing_choice choice.txt is missing. Create it before running.
.data choice_path /home/user/games/crystal-dungeon/choice.txt
.data last_path /home/user/games/crystal-dungeon/last-score.txt
.data high_path /home/user/games/crystal-dungeon/high-score.txt
.data mode_read r
.data mode_write w

start:
MOVI R0 @title
SYSCALL PRINT
MOVI R0 @title2
SYSCALL PRINT
MOVI R0 @title3
SYSCALL PRINT
MOVI R0 @choose
SYSCALL PRINT

# Read the player's gate choice from the persistent virtual disk.
MOVI R0 @choice_path
MOVI R1 @mode_read
SYSCALL OPEN
CMP R0 0
JL choice_missing
MOV R5 R0
MOV R0 R5
MOVI R1 8
SYSCALL READ
MOV R6 R0
MOV R0 R5
SYSCALL CLOSE

CMP R6 1
JZ select_gate_1
CMP R6 2
JZ select_gate_2
CMP R6 3
JZ select_gate_3
JMP choice_invalid

select_gate_1:
MOVI R0 @gate1
SYSCALL PRINT
MOVI R2 55
MOVI R3 100
MOVI R4 100
MOVI R5 0
JMP battle

select_gate_2:
MOVI R0 @gate2
SYSCALL PRINT
MOVI R2 85
MOVI R3 100
MOVI R4 160
MOVI R5 0
JMP battle

select_gate_3:
MOVI R0 @gate3
SYSCALL PRINT
MOVI R2 130
MOVI R3 100
MOVI R4 260
MOVI R5 0
JMP battle

# R2=monster HP, R3=player HP, R4=reward, R5=turn counter.
battle:
INC R5
MOVI R0 12
MOVI R1 31
SYSCALL RANDOM
MOV R1 R0
SUB R2 R1
MOVI R0 @hit
SYSCALL PRINT
MOV R0 R1
SYSCALL PRINT_NUMBER
MOVI R0 @monster_left
SYSCALL PRINT
MOV R0 R2
SYSCALL PRINT_NUMBER
CMP R2 0
JLE won

MOVI R0 6
MOVI R1 23
SYSCALL RANDOM
MOV R1 R0
SUB R3 R1
MOVI R0 @hurt
SYSCALL PRINT
MOV R0 R1
SYSCALL PRINT_NUMBER
MOVI R0 @player_left
SYSCALL PRINT
MOV R0 R3
SYSCALL PRINT_NUMBER
CMP R3 0
JLE lost
JMP battle

won:
MOVI R0 @victory
SYSCALL PRINT
ADD R4 R3
SUB R4 R5
JMP finish

lost:
MOVI R0 @defeat
SYSCALL PRINT
MOV R4 R5
MOVI R1 5
MUL R4 R1

finish:
MOVI R0 @score_label
SYSCALL PRINT
MOV R0 R4
SYSCALL PRINT_NUMBER
MOVI R0 @turns_label
SYSCALL PRINT
MOV R0 R5
SYSCALL PRINT_NUMBER
CALL save_last_score
CALL update_high_score
MOVI R0 0
SYSCALL EXIT

save_last_score:
MOVI R0 @last_path
MOVI R1 @mode_write
SYSCALL OPEN
CMP R0 0
JL save_last_done
MOV R6 R0
MOV R0 R6
MOV R1 R4
SYSCALL WRITE
MOV R0 R6
SYSCALL CLOSE
save_last_done:
RET

update_high_score:
MOVI R0 @high_path
MOVI R1 @mode_read
SYSCALL OPEN
CMP R0 0
JL write_high_score
MOV R6 R0
MOV R0 R6
MOVI R1 32
SYSCALL READ
MOV R7 R0
MOV R0 R6
SYSCALL CLOSE
CMP R4 R7
JG write_high_score
MOVI R0 @old_high
SYSCALL PRINT
MOV R0 R7
SYSCALL PRINT_NUMBER
RET

write_high_score:
MOVI R0 @high_path
MOVI R1 @mode_write
SYSCALL OPEN
CMP R0 0
JL high_score_done
MOV R6 R0
MOV R0 R6
MOV R1 R4
SYSCALL WRITE
MOV R0 R6
SYSCALL CLOSE
MOVI R0 @new_high
SYSCALL PRINT
MOV R0 R4
SYSCALL PRINT_NUMBER
high_score_done:
RET

choice_missing:
MOVI R0 @missing_choice
SYSCALL PRINT
MOVI R0 2
SYSCALL EXIT

choice_invalid:
MOVI R0 @bad_choice
SYSCALL PRINT
MOVI R0 2
SYSCALL EXIT
